The **Revolutionary Sword** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A steel spadroon with a straight, single-edged blade and wooden hilt. It has a medium swing speed, swinging in a diagonal downward slash and a horizontal swipe following that. A downward chop serves as its power attack.
